'''Transceiver dishes''' were devices used for communication. An [[SoroSuub secure uplink station|uplink station]] in [[G'rinn Go city]] on [[Sullust/Legends|Sullust]] was connected to a farm of transceiver dishes. The [[Alliance Comms Center]] on [[Thyferra/Legends|Thyferra]] also made use of transceiver dishes.<ref name="Strongholds">''[[Strongholds of Resistance]]''</ref>
